messages:
Ana (Hiring Manager): Candidate accepted verbally. Edge case: they'd like start 2025-02-01 (earlier than posting), 26 days PTO local, and a split sign-on: 5,000 EUR upfront + 4,500 EUR after 3 months to cover notice + temp housing. Also asking for pro-rated holiday accrual from day one. Can we route?
Rohit (Recruiter): Tagging @Dara and @Eve. Role is L5 Eng, base 162k EUR equivalent. Candidate prefers quick turnaround; manager can't increase base.
Eve (Finance): Heads up: split sign-on where total >5k triggers director signoff. Need cost center: OPS-66009. Payroll will need to know payment schedule for withholding.
Dara (People Ops): Routing rule: any sign-on >5k or multi-part payment needs People Ops Director + Finance ack. PTO deviation from posting also flags. Please provide short business justification.
Ana (Hiring Manager): Business justification: critical infra hire for Q2 launch, unique skills. Team can't wait; earlier start helps ramp. Manager agrees to no base change.
Rohit (Recruiter): Offer draft:
```
Base: 162000 EUR
Equity: 0.5% (4yr)
Sign-on: 5,000 EUR now + 4,500 EUR after 3 months (total 9,500 EUR)
Relocation/temp housing: 2,000 EUR one-time
PTO: 26 days (local statutory), prorated from start
Start: 2025-02-01 (requested earlier)
```
Eve (Finance): Confirming OPS-66009 chargeback ok in principle. Payroll: sign-on treated as taxable; split payments ok but we need payment schedule in payroll request. No gross-up by default.
Lena (People Ops Director): I can approve the split sign-on totaling 9,500 EUR, 26 days PTO, and the earlier start given business need, contingent on Finance payroll schedule and legal loop if cross-border. Approve conditional on final payroll memo and manager acknowledgement of no gross-up.
Rohit (Recruiter): I'll add conditional language to the offer: "Offer contingent on final payroll tax and payment schedule confirmation." Sending draft to candidate now.
offer-bot: Offer created (draft) REQ-66009: https://redwood.example/offers/REQ-66009
Dara (People Ops): Logging exception EX-2025-045 for record (split sign-on + PTO deviation). After signed offer, Ops will issue final approval memo to payroll and run legal check if needed.
Ana (Hiring Manager): Thanks all — pushing verbal with conditional language now.
Lena (People Ops Director): Approved-in-principle. Follow-ups: payroll schedule, legal if cross-border, final sign-off memo after acceptance."
